data.name: Kritavya
data.gender_notes: Kritavya is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘kri’ meaning to do and ‘tavya’ meaning bound or obligated. It signifies a person who is deeply committed to their duties and responsibilities. The name Kritavya carries the meaning “Duty bound, obligated” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Kritavya usually hope their child will grow to embody duty bound, obligated and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Embodiment of duty, honor, and responsibility.
data.etymology: Kritavya belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Duty bound, obligated.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kritavya total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Kritavya" signifies a strong sense of duty, honor, and responsibility within Hindu culture. The name carries an expectation of commitment to one's duties as well as to one's community and family. In this way, the name emphasizes the importance of taking action and living up to one's obligations.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Kritavya" can be seen as a reminder of the inner call to duty and service. It encourages introspection, self-reflection, and a deep commitment to living in alignment with one's dharma or purpose in life. The name also reflects the idea that every action we take, no matter how small, has an impact on the world around us and on our own spiritual growth. In this way, the name "Kritavya" inspires us to be mindful and purposeful in all that we do, and to use our actions as a means to bring positive change into the world.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Kritavya signifies one who is bound by duty or obligation. It is a reminder of the moral and ethical responsibilities that every individual holds towards themselves, others, and the universe. The pursuit of dharma, or righteous action, is a fundamental aspect of this name.

historical_references.reference: Kritavya is mentioned in the Mahabharata as the name of a sage who was a disciple of Vyasa and the preceptor of the Pandava prince Bhima. He is also called Bhima-guru.
historical_references.context: ancient Indian epic poetry and mythology

historical_references.reference: Kritavya is also mentioned in the Puranic literature, particularly in the Mahabharata and the Bhagavad Purana, as a sage who performed a great penance to obtain the boon of immortality. He is also known as Kritavasa and Kritavarma.

It is often used as a name for individuals or communities that are dedicated to fulfilling their duties or taking action towards self-improvement. The name Kritavya is seen on several platforms including blogs and websites, social media, and mobile applications. On blogs and websites, one can find blogs and articles written by individuals who have adopted the name Kritavya as a symbol of their commitment to personal growth and self-improvement. On social media, there are numerous accounts and groups dedicated to the name and its associated values. On mobile applications, there are several apps that offer guided meditation, mindfulness practices, and personal development resources under the name Kritavya. The general trend is towards utilizing technology to make spiritual and personal growth practices more accessible and convenient for individuals seeking to improve themselves and lead more fulfilling lives.
